denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: June 27, 2023
Claim: Outpatient psychotherapy, sessions 21-24, June 2023
Reason Code: CO-G8

Benefits are not available for the above sessions. Your plan provides twenty outpatient
behavioral health visits per calendar year under Section 6.9, and that limit has been reached.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days of this notice.
denial_reason: Benefits are not available for the above sessions. Your plan provides twenty outpatient behavioral health visits per calendar year under Section 6.9, and that limit has been reached.

sub_claims.text: Your plan provides twenty outpatient behavioral health visits per calendar year under Section 6.9, and that limit has been reached.
sub_claims.rationale: The policy states that outpatient behavioral health visits are covered up to twenty visits per calendar year (p-6-9). However, Section 6.10 provides a carve-back stating that treatment limitations for mental health and substance use disorder benefits cannot be more restrictive than those applied to medical and surgical benefits. Since the visit limit does not apply to outpatient medical or surgical office visits (p-6-11), it is unclear if this carve-back applies specifically to behavioral health visits, but it suggests that such a limit might not stand in comparison with other types of covered services.
